en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a richly decorated historic townhouse facade with elaborate sculpted ornamentation around the windows and door. There is a shop at street level with an awning and signage, and an old street lamp mounted on an ornate bracket. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as the Maison des Ambassadeurs in Dijon, France, with a small serial number and publisher initials.
